mechanism: Both drugs are teratogens affecting different pathways; dutasteride inhibits 5-alpha reductase while tazarotene is a retinoid that increases teratogenic risk, and both may have additive effects on skin irritation and photosensitivity.
action: Avoid concurrent use in patients of childbearing potential; use effective contraception if co-administration is necessary, and counsel on increased risk of birth defects and enhanced dermatologic adverse effects.
